findings.description: When the customer first enters the diner, he walks out from behind the service counter and kitchen pass-through area at the back of the room right next to the waitress, whereas the diner's actual entrance/exit door is at the opposite end of the building (as seen at 00:45).

As coffee is poured into the mug, the glass carafe is held nearly upright without tilting enough for liquid to reach the spout, the stream emerges anomalously through the upper front wall of the pot, and the liquid level inside the carafe remains completely static.

The plate of toast and egg sitting in front of the man at 00:36–00:44 completely disappears from the counter during the wide shot from 01:00 to 01:08 (leaving only his coffee mug), then abruptly reappears in front of him at 01:09 so the waitress can clear it.

Two hands enter from opposite sides of the counter (left and right) as if belonging to two different people facing each other. As the left hand lifts away, the top bill warps upward on its own and displays mismatched denominations ('1' in the top-left corner and '100' in both bottom corners).

findings.invariant_violated: Vehicle continuity and optical reflection physics
findings.description: The vehicle outside changes from a white sleeper-cab semi-tractor (00:00–00:09) to a dark green box truck. Additionally, the waitress's reflection appears mapped directly onto the green side panel of the truck behind the man (who walks in front of the reflection despite being outside the window), and at 01:48–01:49 her reflection remains stationary staring forward even after the real waitress turns and walks away.

After the waitress stands up from the stool and walks into the foreground to go behind the counter at 01:51–01:52, a second identical copy of the waitress materializes in the background near the kitchen pass-through, resulting in two identical waitresses working behind the counter simultaneously through 01:58.
